definitions.explanation: A geographical area defined for the purposes of local government administration. In Japan, this typically refers to the wards within designated cities (政令指定都市) or other administrative subdivisions.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{七|なな}つ→七つ：02926_nanatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行政区|ぎょうせいく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かれている→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: This city is divided into seven administrative wards.

examples.japanese: {行政区|ぎょうせいく}ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられている→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: Service counters are set up for each administrative district.

examples.japanese: {横浜市|よこはまし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十八|じゅうはち}→十八：00948_juuhachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行政区|ぎょうせいく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{区役所|くやくしょ}→区役所：21563_kuyakusho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Yokohama has eighteen administrative wards, each with its own ward office.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{行政|ぎょうせい}→行政：14122_gyousei⟧ (administration; government) and ⟦{区|く}→〜区：01997_ku⟧ (ward; district). Refers specifically to divisions created for administrative purposes, as opposed to natural or informal regional boundaries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {行政区|ぎょうせいく}{画|かく}: administrative division/demarcation
- {行政区|ぎょうせいく}{域|いき}: administrative district area
- {行政区|ぎょうせいく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{再編|さいへん}→再編：07656_saihen⟧: reorganization of administrative districts
- {行政区|ぎょうせいく}{分|ぶん}け: division into administrative wards

JAPANESE ADMINISTRATIVE DIVISIONS:
In Japan, {行政区|ぎょうせいく} typically refers to the wards (⟦{区|く}→〜区：01997_ku⟧) within {政令指定都市|せいれいしていとし} (designated cities) such as {大阪市|おおさかし}, {横浜市|よこはまし}, and {名古屋市|なごやし}. These are distinct from Tokyo's ⟦{特別区|とくべつく}→特別区：28159_tokubetsuku⟧ (special wards), which have greater autonomy.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{区|く}→〜区：01997_ku⟧: ward — the ward itself, without the administrative connotation
- ⟦{選挙区|せんきょく}→選挙区：15097_senkyoku⟧: electoral district — a district defined for voting purposes
- ⟦{自治体|じちたい}→自治体：13946_jichitai⟧: municipality; local government — the governing body itself, not the geographical area
